# Pre-market brief, Tue 2026-11-10 (written ~8:20 AM ET)

1. **October CPI at 8:30 ET is the day's swing factor.** Consensus headline +0.3% m/m, core +0.2% (Sept: +0.6% / +0.3%); y/y won't be published because Oct 2025 wasn't collected ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-today-live-updates.html); [Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/us-inflation-data-ahead-huang-scandal-fallout--whats-moving-markets-5014413)). Fed Gov. Waller called a December hike likely and opened the door to 50bp ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)); market prices ~84% for a Dec hike. Fed Chair Warsh speaks today; 10-yr auction today; bond market closed Wed ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/de-ch/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---wall-street-rebounds-and-brent-slides-below-usd-92---10-november-2026-10112026)).
2. **Futures mixed after Monday's best day since April:** Dow +0.3%, S&P ~flat, Nasdaq-100 −0.3/−0.4% ([Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-tuesday-november-10-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-inflation-data-cpi-090627830.html); [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-today-live-updates.html)).
3. **Rates/oil/BTC:** 2-yr ~4.56%, 10-yr ~4.88%, yields up; Brent ~$92, WTI ~$86, lowest since early Sept on Iran de-escalation (Iran set 7 conditions for talks); BTC ~$74.5k, lagging with ETF outflows ([Saxo](https://www.home.saxo/de-ch/content/articles/macro/market-quick-take---wall-street-rebounds-and-brent-slides-below-usd-92---10-november-2026-10112026); [Thrive](https://thriveinmarkets.com/market-insights/morning-analysis-2026-11-10/)).
4. **Movers:** SANM +21% (FQ4 adj EPS $4.43 vs $3.27, FY27 guide above), AAON +18–22% (Q3 rev $707.4M vs $599.7M, FY26 growth raised to 72–75%, data-center cooling) ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-sanmina-aaon-surge-hims--hers-rocket-lab-fall-5015063); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/aaon-shares-surge-22-premarket-114230425.html)). NVDA +1.8% to $181.94 (probe ongoing, FBI looking, class action filed); HIMS −3.7% (Q4 rev guide $875–895M vs ~$955M); RKLB −5.7% (wider loss, Neutron delayed to 2027) ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-sanmina-aaon-surge-hims--hers-rocket-lab-fall-5015063)). SE −9% (adj EPS $0.78 vs $0.99) ([Investing](https://ca.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/sea-limited-shares-tumble-9-on-third-quarter-earnings-miss-93CH-4946028)); ONON −5% (beat flattered by CHF 52.6M tariff refund) ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/on-holding-shares-fall-5-in-premarket-as-tariff-refund-flatters-q3-profit-beat-5014565)); TDG −1.4% (FY27 EPS guide short) ([SA](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4669653-transdigm-group-slips-as-profit-outlook-falls-short-of-estimates)).
5. **Earnings ahead:** CRWV AMC today; CTVA 11/11 AMC; NBIS 11/12 BMO; AMAT, CSCO 11/12 AMC; DIS 11/17 BMO (carried from prior calendar).
6. **Data this week:** CPI today 8:30; jobless claims Thu 8:30; PPI Fri 8:30.

**Ideas:** No new swing longs. CPI is minutes away, Nasdaq futures are red after a first bounce from the AI-hardware shock (group avoid runs through today), and the two big gappers (SANM, AAON) are >5% gaps in the AI-infra group, so the skip-open rule applies; revisit at close. Carry HUM (med, hold only): beat-and-raise, risk is MA cost trend. No re-add.
